replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states 1-year retention of full bodies for debugging; bulk exposure of customer data is concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Design explicitly logs login request bodies; credential harvesting by log readers is a distinct attack."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Response bodies logged; token replay to impersonate users is a distinct attack from password harvesting."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design names payment details logged for a year; card data theft is distinct harm and data."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Unconditional full-body logging supports log storage/quota exhaustion attack degrading debugging and detection."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Caller-controlled bodies written verbatim into logs; forged records poisoning investigations is a distinct attack."}]}
